[ 1 ] Renáta Jamrichová and Federica Urgesi were the reigning champions, [ 2 ] but Urgesi was no longer eligible to participate in junior events. Jamrichová partnered Isabelle Lacy, but lost in the second round to Maya Joint and Kristiana Sidorova.
